verdict.rationale: An online taxpayer portal could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on a user's filings or account data, so this axis applies. The evidence pack only documents filing, payment, license renewal, refund status and live human support, with no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the portal. The llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
